paragraphs.source_en: Mines rip holes in my force. Bellona kill squads slip out of the wall a hundred meters up, flying out in glory—banners waving, gold glistening. Their shields shimmer as they’re lanced by weapon fire. I see an eagle banner amidst the Bellona, and ready to set myself against it, thinking it must be Cassius, but Mustang grabs my arm.

units.source_en: Mines rip holes in my force.
Bellona kill squads slip out of the wall a hundred meters up, flying out in glory—banners waving, gold glistening.
Their shields shimmer as they’re lanced by weapon fire.
I see an eagle banner amidst the Bellona, and ready to set myself against it, thinking it must be Cassius, but Mustang grabs my arm.

paragraphs.source_en: “The plan!” Mustang reminds me, pointing to the river. “We’ll all die against that wall. The plan.”

units.source_en: “The plan!”
Mustang reminds me, pointing to the river.
“We’ll all die against that wall.
The plan.”

paragraphs.source_en: Hard to remember. Hard to remember all this chaos is a distraction. What matters is the river and the work done in the night by the Sons. If they did it. The river slithers under the wall. One hundred meters wide, and more deep, it already carries corpses toward the city.

units.source_en: Hard to remember.
Hard to remember all this chaos is a distraction.
What matters is the river and the work done in the night by the Sons.
If they did it.
The river slithers under the wall.

ja.t: のようにくぐっている。

units.source_en: One hundred meters wide, and more deep, it already carries corpses toward the city.

paragraphs.source_en: I dive into the water. Feel the tension as the current slows, then speeds my path. Fish scatter before us. Odd not feeling the chill. The Howlers move like torpedoes beside me. Then Ragnar is with us and his group of Obsidians. Jupiter too, all splashing down under water. Mustang is closest me. I scan the river ahead through the murk we kicked up and find Ares’s gift.

units.source_en: I dive into the water.
Feel the tension as the current slows, then speeds my path.
Fish scatter before us.
Odd not feeling the chill.
The Howlers move like torpedoes beside me.
Then Ragnar is with us and his group of Obsidians.
Jupiter too, all splashing down under water.
Mustang is closest me.
I scan the river ahead through the murk we kicked up and find Ares’s gift.

paragraphs.source_en: There. A hundred meters deep, I see it. If there’s one things Reds can do, it’s drill. And the Sons spent the night preparing to give us passage into the city. My men will think some elite lurcher squad was sent here before the armada. They will not question how the huge grates were cut, or how the sensors meant to detect damage to the grating were fooled.

units.source_en: There.
A hundred meters deep, I see it.
If there’s one things Reds can do, it’s drill.

ja.t: つあるとすれば、それは

units.source_en: And the Sons spent the night preparing to give us passage into the city.
My men will think some elite lurcher squad was sent here before the armada.
They will not question how the huge grates were cut, or how the sensors meant to detect damage to the grating were fooled.

ja.t: するはずのセンサーがどう

paragraphs.source_en: “Once more unto the breech,” I murmur, as if Roque, Victra, or Tactus could hear me. I activate my gravBoots and move forward.

units.source_en: “Once more unto the breech,” I murmur, as if Roque, Victra, or Tactus could hear me.

ja.t: はつぶやく。まるでロークやヴィクトラやタクタスに

units.source_en: I activate my gravBoots and move forward.

paragraphs.source_en: The passage is narrow as it curls beneath the wall near the bottom of the riverbed. We travel two abreast. So I take the best fighter with me, Ragnar, as we move first through the underwater passage. My com crackles with news of the battle above. We’re losing at the wall.

units.source_en: The passage is narrow as it curls beneath the wall near the bottom of the riverbed.
We travel two abreast.
So I take the best fighter with me, Ragnar, as we move first through the underwater passage.
My com crackles with news of the battle above.
We’re losing at the wall.

paragraphs.source_en: Ragnar and I clear the tunnel together. I half expected a Bellona ambush, but none comes. The Sons did their job well. We wait on the opposite side of the wall, still submerged, one hundred meters down at the bottom of the riverbed. The rest of my cadre join Ragnar and me—Mustang, Sevro, and the remaining Howlers. Fifty more Golds and three times that many Obsidians and Grays.

units.source_en: Ragnar and I clear the tunnel together.
I half expected a Bellona ambush, but none comes.
The Sons did their job well.
We wait on the opposite side of the wall, still submerged, one hundred meters down at the bottom of the riverbed.
The rest of my cadre join Ragnar and me—Mustang, Sevro, and the remaining Howlers.

ja.t: する。ムスタング、セヴロ、そして

units.source_en: Fifty more Golds and three times that many Obsidians and Grays.

paragraphs.source_en: I speak into my com when we’ve all gathered at the bottom of the river. “You know your orders.”

units.source_en: I speak into my com when we’ve all gathered at the bottom of the river.
“You know your orders.”
